title: Enhanced Combat Page View
description: Port of Cyaminthe's Enhanced Combat Page View (Workshop 2802216129) as host callbacks on observation gates: the selected combat page in the hand is zoomed (25% bigger by default). For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Enhanced Combat Page View
launcher.note: Gives you the ability to Zoom-in combat pages on your hand, along with other fixes. Original mod by [Cyaminthe’s Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2802216129)

settings.label: Selected page zoom (%)
settings.note: How much bigger the selected combat page is. 125 is 25% bigger.
